text.tspan: 1 · 11:48 stale check
make the write conditional on the applied generation,
checked by the receiver in the same operation (fencing token);
if it can't check → single writer
does NOT solve: a newer plan that is wrong
2 · 11:48 cleanup
floor under destructive automation:
never delete what's active; never publish 0 targets
(or far below last size) without a human
does NOT solve: a plan that is bad but not empty
3 · 00:38 identification
synthetic DNS check: page on 0 answers
or a sudden drop in answer count; make it the page that names the cause
does NOT solve: the fix; it detects, it doesn't contain
4 · 06:45–09:36 capacity removed
cap removals per interval + tested failover kill switch;
freeze what removes/replaces healthy instances; leave scale-out on
does NOT solve: truly dead instances; it adds no capacity
5 · 02:25–05:28 dependency returns
drill fleet-wide re-establishment vs timeout;
drop expired work; write the recovery runbook
does NOT solve: the outage itself; it decides how you come back
